paragraphs.text:
TELL-EL-AMARNA
The village is quiet. A gust of wind picks up dust along the 
empty road. Here and there a face looks out from a doorway. You 
spot the pyramid, one much smaller and less imposing than the 
pyramids at Giza. A well-trod path leads to the pyramid entrance. 
If you have time to inspect the pyramid, go to 360. If you need 
to spend the night at the inn, go to 444. If you left your car with 
the guide, go to 361.
(Egypt Location)
